<function name="PopulateChildrenAndSelf" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>

Called automatically from <page>DTree_Node:SetExpanded</page> (or when user manually expands the node) to populate the node with sub-nodes from the filesystem if this was enabled via <page>DTree_Node:MakeFolder</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="expand" type="boolean">Expand self once population process is finished.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
